x: The winners of the team race were Bristol A.C., which was a just reward for their long journey, and who should be with them but our old past President, Teddy Gordon, and you can imagine his pleasure at their success and in our getting third.

Teddy Gordon provided some building brick money boxes in which the surplus halfpennies could be placed each evening. Frank Elson came along with a scheme based on football results which added to our funds and was succeeded by a more ambitious scheme still, organised by Frank Elson and Tom Cotton and…

With Teddy Gordon's aid, wooden money boxes were made, called Belgrave Bricks, and these were distributed to nearly all members. In announcing the scheme's inauguration Harry Hare said "This scheme will not cost you a penny".
